question: In February 2025, which company partnered with Roche Diagnostics for a self-sampling HPV DNA test in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Metropolis Healthcare**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **February 2025**, **Metropolis Healthcare**, a leading diagnostic service provider in India, partnered with **Roche Diagnostics** to introduce a self-sampling **HPV DNA test** in India.
 
• The test aims to provide an innovative and non-invasive approach to screen for **human papillomavirus (HPV)**, which is a significant cause of cervical cancer.
 
• Metropolis Healthcare's focus on advanced diagnostic solutions and Roche Diagnostics' expertise in diagnostic technologies make this collaboration a step towards enhancing women's health in India.
 
• This partnership intends to address the challenges of early detection of cervical cancer, which is a leading cause of cancer-related deaths among women in India.
 
• The self-sampling method empowers women by offering convenience, privacy, and accessibility, especially in rural and underserved areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Metropolis Healthcare:**

 
 
• Founded in **1980**, it is one of India’s leading diagnostic service providers, with a strong presence across **India and internationally**.
 
• Metropolis specializes in **clinical laboratory services, pathology, and preventive health check-ups**.
 
• It operates a network of **diagnostic centers** and offers over **4,000 tests** covering a wide range of diseases and health conditions.
 
 
 
• **Roche Diagnostics:**
 
 
• Roche Diagnostics is a division of the Swiss multinational healthcare company **Roche**.
 
• It is a global leader in in-vitro diagnostics and **cancer diagnostics**.
 
• The company is recognized for its cutting-edge diagnostic technologies, including PCR-based tests, which are pivotal in disease detection and management.
 
 
 
• **HPV DNA Test:**
 
 
• HPV (Human Papillomavirus) is a group of viruses, some of which are linked to cervical cancer.
 
• The HPV DNA test detects the genetic material of the virus, enabling early identification of women at risk.
 
• Self-sampling HPV DNA tests allow women to collect samples themselves, making the process less invasive compared to traditional Pap smears.
 
 
 
• **Cervical Cancer in India:**
 
 
• Cervical cancer is the **second most common cancer** among women in India.
 
• According to the **WHO**, India accounts for a significant proportion of the global cervical cancer burden.
 
• Early detection through regular screening can significantly reduce mortality rates.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Significance of Early Detection:**

 
 
• Early detection of HPV and cervical cancer can lead to better treatment outcomes and reduced healthcare costs.
 
• WHO recommends regular screening and vaccination against HPV as effective strategies for cervical cancer prevention.
 
 
 
• **Global Impact:**
 
 
• HPV DNA tests have been widely adopted in several countries as a reliable method for cervical cancer screening.
 
• India's adoption of advanced diagnostic methods reflects its commitment to improving public health infrastructure.
